title: Where the held error comes from, and the leukemia study at full depth
set_out: The leukemia study first, then the firm rate, then Met-A with the atlas as the ruler, then megakaryocytes and plasma, then replays if machines are free (author's order).

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The division route, IMR90 dividing and resting (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: Nine IMR90 samples (proliferating, senescent, dividing past senescence with SV40) counted by the one command at 10 million read pairs.
entries.outcome: Dividing adds about a twentieth of the held error; the cells still dividing with SV40 read the senescent level. Replication error is not the firm rate's missing half; upkeep itself is.

entries.title: R9, glioma patients' blood and cultured endothelial cells (OTH-082, DEV-REPLICATE-01)
entries.what: 76 glioma bloods and 39 endothelial cultures, each read by the one command.
entries.outcome: New glioblastoma blood reads higher whole-sample Met-A than lower-grade glioma blood, with far more neutrophils; endothelial cells from idiopathic pulmonary arterial hypertension read lower than controls, most on the domains territory.

entries.title: The first leukemia at full depth (GRP-020, DEV-ALL-INFO-01)
entries.what: ALL-45 aligned across 20 machines and read by the one command.
entries.outcome: Its held error reproduces its pass-1 count within a few percent.

entries.title: The graded maintenance test written; its synthetic met (PHY-006, DEV-ERASE-01)
entries.what: Mouse stem cells with a DNMT1 inhibitor at three doses, to tell a slowed restoring rate from a lowered holding fraction; written before any count.
entries.outcome: The synthetic recovers both cases on its third run; the counts are on GitHub.

entries.title: Met-A with the atlas as the ruler: test written; its synthetic met (GRP-019, DEV-METAA-ATLAS-CURVE-01)
entries.what: Identity sites chosen on IAM-Atlas v2.1, each array read on its own response curve; healthy purified monocytes from three laboratories the atlas does not hold.
entries.outcome: The synthetic is met on its third run; the first laboratory's 15 arrays are on GitHub.

entries.title: Full-depth sequencing: the molecule step and the merge fixed (GRP-020)
entries.what: The molecule step rebuilds wgbstools' dictionary and retries when the prebuilt one fails; the merge finds the chunks' files where the artifacts put them, and can merge an earlier run's chunks without aligning again.
entries.outcome: Every chunk of the Reh control wrote its molecules; the merge is run on them.

entries.title: The held error tile by tile, and the split alignment's last chunk (PHY-006, GRP-020)
entries.what: Stage Q2 counts the held error per tile in two independent halves; a fetch block whose read files differ keeps its true pairs.

entries.title: Each sample read as its stated specimen; cell lines read and flagged (GRP-020)
entries.what: The leukemia study's sample list carries each sample's specimen; intake reads a cell line on the full-atlas route.
entries.outcome: Every full-depth sample is read again from its merged molecules.

open_at_turnover: Running on GitHub's machines: the leukemia study's Reh control and its UHRF1 knockout at full depth, each split across 20 machines, then merged and read by the one command.
